  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `SCOPE_LABEL_PREEXISTING` is set from `ISSUE_META_FILE`, a snapshot fetched once at job start. The "Validate planning phase label" `/answer` release at lines 1057-1066 removes `ai:scope-blocked` later in the same job, so if the re-plan blocks on scope again and the handler re-adds the label, the stale snapshot still marks it as pre-existing and both rollbacks (line 2427 failed label edit, line 2506 failed comment post) are skipped.
  WHY: If the label edit or comment post fails, the issue keeps an `ai:scope-blocked` label that this run added, with no new marker comment. That breaks the "added together or not at all" invariant, and `unblock_ledger.latest_rejection` then offers `override_guard` on the older, already-answered marker's path list. All four reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high). The new tests use only static fixtures and do not cover a release earlier in the same job.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2412-2416 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The rollback's "this run added the label" check uses a pre-run snapshot instead of an atomic ownership check, and neither plan.yml nor workflow-templates/ai-plan.yml has a per-issue `concurrency:` group. Two overlapping `/answer` runs can therefore both compute `SCOPE_LABEL_PREEXISTING=false`.
  WHY: Run A posts a valid marker and adds the label. Run B's comment post then fails, and its rollback (line 2506) removes A's live `ai:scope-blocked` latch. The issue then resolves to `blocked` instead of `scope-blocked`, and `override_guard` is no longer offered. All reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high); confidence differed (3 from minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, 4 from openai_gpt-6-luna), and the max is used.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:1057-1066 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The new `gh api user` call is made without ensuring it complies with the `gh` API write guard and the test suite's expectations for API call authorization, as shown by test failures in `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py`.
  WHY: The CI failures indicate the API-call authorization contract is violated, which could lead to unauthorized or unverified API access attempts in production. The reviewer stated no severity.
- tests/test_operator_step_issue.py:N/A | confidence=3

- scripts/plan_scope_block_route.sh:1-298 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]

  WHY: It has only a simple gate (`PLAN_SCOPE_BLOCK_ROUTING_ENABLED`) and adds a new path for routing planning blocks with no supervisor or dedicated long-running gate beyond workflow-level variables. The reviewer stated no severity.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:"Handle blocked planning output", lines 2412-2416; rollbacks at line 2427 and line 2506; `ISSUE_META_FILE` fetched once at line 903; label removed at lines 1057-1066 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `SCOPE_LABEL_PREEXISTING` comes from the line-903 metadata snapshot, which is never refetched. When `/answer` releases the latch (release=true) and the new run blocks on scope again, the re-added label is treated as pre-existing, so both rollbacks are skipped.
  WHY: A failed comment post (line 2502) or label edit (line 2420) leaves `ai:scope-blocked` with no new header or marker. That breaks the "added together or not at all" invariant, and `unblock_ledger.latest_rejection` offers `override_guard` on a stale path list. This is a regression introduced by the last run. The new tests (`test_failed_comment_post_removes_only_the_scope_label_this_run_added`, `test_failed_label_edit_never_removes_a_pre_existing_scope_latch`) do not cover an earlier release in the same job.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. The "no new GitHub API calls" deviation was recorded as TASK_GAP_DEFERRED in earlier rounds; treating a header with no marker as `missing` follows AD-1 (A).
- HARDENING (risk 3, about 6+6 lines): In the validate step, write `PLAN_SCOPE_LATCH_RELEASED=true` to `$GITHUB_ENV` when release succeeds (drop `|| true` for that case). In the handler, reset `SCOPE_LABEL_PREEXISTING=false` when that variable is set. Add a test case to `tests/test_plan_clarify_blocked_output.py` with `GH_FAIL_MATCH=issues/746/comments`.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:lines 2409-2416 (`SCOPE_LABEL_PREEXISTING` derivation), consumed at line 2427 and line 2506; snapshot written at line 903; invalidated at lines 1057-1066 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `ISSUE_META_FILE` is written once (line 903) and never refreshed. The answer-release branch removes `ai:scope-blocked` (`PLAN_SCOPE_RELEASE_ARGS=(--remove-label 'ai:scope-blocked')`), and the handler re-adds it at line 2421 but treats it as pre-existing, so neither rollback removes it.
  WHY: In the release-then-reblock flow with a failed comment post, the issue keeps `ai:scope-blocked` with no current marker. `unblock_ledger.latest_rejection` (scripts/unblock_ledger.py:579-632) then picks the previous marker and offers `override_guard` for the old path set.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:lines 2412-2416 versus line 1066 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The flag answers "was the label present before this run started" instead of "was it present immediately before this run's own edit". The two differ because line 1066 mutates the label in the same job.
  WHY: The conservative-rollback fix is decided from a snapshot that is two label mutations out of date, so it disables the rollback it was meant to enable (same root cause as the item above).
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:lines 2412-2416, line 2506; workflow-templates/ai-plan.yml lines 3-64 (no concurrency group) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Neither ai-plan.yml nor plan.yml has a `concurrency:` block (unlike implement.yml and clarify.yml), so two `/answer` runs can overlap and both compute `SCOPE_LABEL_PREEXISTING=false`.
  WHY: Run B's failed comment post triggers a rollback at line 2506 that removes run A's valid `ai:scope-blocked`. `stop_for_labels` then resolves to `blocked`, and `override_guard` is no longer offered.
- SECURITY, ERROR PATHS, NAMING, TRUST-BOUNDARY, TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE (with verification notes).
- HARDENING (3 related items): (1) Publish `PLAN_SCOPE_LATCH_RELEASED=true` at line 1062 and reset `SCOPE_LABEL_PREEXISTING=false` in the handler, plus a release-then-reblock test (4-8 lines, risk 3). (2) Re-read the issue labels before the edit at line 2420, or gate the rollback on the run's own comment-post success (6-10 lines, risk 3). (3) scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh `apply_judge_files_touched_companions`: command substitution strips the trailing newline from `JUDGE_COMPANIONS_BODY`, which is cosmetic; append it back when `added=<n>` (3 lines, risk 1).
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
